claims.counts: Repeated slots/rounds and separately executed names count checks, not unique encodings or exhaustive domains. Native checks are separate. Full target waveforms were not downloaded.
claims.failure: Step preserves the documented first>=second oracle and zero gate. Target aborts at the first strict semantic check; no full-case, finalized-image, heap-recovery or timing claim for that failed benchmark.
claims.performance: All successful runs are same-ELF controls. Absolute callback times are retained with no saving, isolated operator cost, whole-instrument utilization or deadline claim.
claims.recovery: Root-operated application-only tests restore the identified instrument. This publisher performs no device operation. Initial restoration timeout is retained separately.
claims.scope: Twenty exact source forms passed the supplied four finite input programs. Step remains a documented mathematical failure, not a qualified alias or performance result.
claims.surface: Each exact call/infix/prefix context is separately bound. ?: uses registry lookup ?; equal generated code does not qualify unexecuted names, RNBO patcher/codebox, visual Gen or arbitrary user programs.
claims.truth: Independent documented binary64 comparisons and numeric truthiness over exact binary32 inputs; +/-zero false and nonzero subnormals true. Sign oracle zero is canonical+0; operation zero signs are separate diagnostics. Conditional selects the other lane for nonzero condition and its negation otherwise.
